findings.claim: For Gemini 2.5 Flash (a model earlier than Gemini 3), thinking is controlled by thinking_budget: when unset the model controls it automatically, the settable range is 1 to 24,576 tokens, and setting it to 0 prevents thought content from being returned -- though the source qualifies that reasoning-style text may still appear in the output. Using thinking_level with a model earlier than Gemini 3 makes the model return an error.

findings.claim: The CountTokens API carries no monetary charge. The same passage also states a maximum quota of 3000 requests per minute, so this evidence supports a zero-price claim and a 3000 RPM rate-limit claim together; it does not support a claim that no quota applies.

findings.claim: For Gemini 2.5 Flash, text/image/video input is $0.30 per 1M tokens and text output (response and reasoning) is $2.50 per 1M tokens, with the same price in both prompt-length tiers.

pricing_units.derivation: 1 USD = 1000000 microdollar; $0.30 per 1000000 tokens = 300000/1000000 = 3/10 microdollar per token; $2.50 per 1000000 tokens = 2500000/1000000 = 5/2 microdollar per token
